_evidence: 0x005581ba ORs together the dwords [ebx*4+0x875dc8] selected by the set bits of ax ('shr ax,1; jb or; jne'), ebx = bit index 0..15, so it reads the 16-dword table 0x875dc8..0x875e07. fuzz:i32 varied only dword 0; all 16 are random here (plain OR operands: every value is valid), so a wrong index or a missed bit changes eax.
